# Doctor Dave

## Overview

- **Role:** doctor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P18](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P32](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P18](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0018), +1 more</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Doctor Dave is an elderly, large, and cheerful man. He is also distinguished by his white whiskers.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)_

## Personality

Doctor Dave is a gruff individual who lacks tact. He is known for making insensitive remarks, such as carelessly speaking of ropes around those who have lost someone to hanging.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054)_

## History

Doctor Dave maintained a forty-year feud with the over-harbor people. He joined Mrs. Doctor Dave and Captain Jim in welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) over supper, where he shared stories about the local community. On another occasion, he listened alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as Captain Jim recounted the historical romance of [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P34](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--doctor-dave.md)

Doctor Dave is considered a friend of [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), who views him as one of the few men she genuinely respects. Their relationship represents a rare instance of her holding a man in high regard.
